HELLOSPIRE-LOAD.title: Load
HELLOSPIRE-LOAD.description: Place a Round into the first empty chamber clockwise from the hammer. If every chamber is full, replace from the hammer forwards; the replaced ammunition is discarded. Loading never moves the hammer.
HELLOSPIRE-FIRE.title: Fire
HELLOSPIRE-FIRE.description: Resolve the chamber under the hammer, then advance the hammer one chamber clockwise. A loaded chamber deals its Round's damage as Attack damage and resolves its effect.
HELLOSPIRE-CYCLE.title: Cycle
HELLOSPIRE-CYCLE.description: Advance the hammer clockwise without firing.
HELLOSPIRE-SPIN.title: Spin
HELLOSPIRE-SPIN.description: Move the hammer to a random chamber. The result is revealed once it resolves.
HELLOSPIRE-CLICK.title: Click
HELLOSPIRE-CLICK.description: A Fire that resolves an empty chamber. No damage and no effect, but the hammer still advances.
HELLOSPIRE-SELF_FIRE.title: Self-Fire
HELLOSPIRE-SELF_FIRE.description: Resolve the chamber under the hammer at yourself. A loaded chamber costs HP equal to its Round's printed damage, ignoring Strength, Weak, Vulnerable, Deadeye, Block and Armor. Its other effects do not trigger.
HELLOSPIRE-THE_CYLINDER.title: Cylinder
HELLOSPIRE-THE_CYLINDER.description: Your revolver: six chambers and a hammer that advances clockwise. Rounds are Loaded into it and spent by Firing.
HELLOSPIRE-MATCHED_AMMO.title: Matched Ammunition
HELLOSPIRE-MATCHED_AMMO.description: Rounds borrowed from another player come out of their kit: Ironclad lends Heavy, Silent lends Crippling, Defect lends Piercing, Regent lends Guard, Necrobinder lends Rending, Paladin lends Guard, Alchemist lends Smoke. Anyone else, including yourself, lends Lead.
HELLOSPIRE-BREW.title: Brew
HELLOSPIRE-BREW.description: Create the [gold]Volatile[/gold] version of a Potion in your first empty Potion Slot. If no Slot is empty, the Potion is lost.
HELLOSPIRE-VOLATILE.title: Volatile
HELLOSPIRE-VOLATILE.description: This Potion behaves normally -- it occupies a Slot, costs no Energy, and triggers Potion effects -- but it is removed at the end of combat.
HELLOSPIRE-DISTILL.title: Distill
HELLOSPIRE-DISTILL.description: Discard one of your Potions without resolving it, in exchange for the card's listed reward. Distilling is not using a Potion, but it does empty a Slot.
HELLOSPIRE-POTENCY.title: Potency
HELLOSPIRE-POTENCY.description: Whenever you use a Volatile Potion, its damage and Block values are increased by your Potency. Never applies to found or bought Potions.
HELLOSPIRE-THE_POTION_BELT.title: The Potion Belt
HELLOSPIRE-THE_POTION_BELT.description: Your Potion Slots. Cards can grant extra Slots for one combat; those Slots hold only Volatile Potions.
HELLOSPIRE-GADGET.title: Gadget
HELLOSPIRE-GADGET.description: A card that uses no ammunition: it never [gold]Loads[/gold], [gold]Fires[/gold], [gold]Cycles[/gold] or [gold]Spins[/gold]. Gadgets are worth the same with the [gold]Cylinder[/gold] empty as with it full, and some cards care how many you play.
HELLOSPIRE-SEAL.title: Seal
HELLOSPIRE-SEAL.description: A banked charge. Seals STACK: every cast pays its immediate effect and banks one charge -- the number on the seal icon is how many charges you hold. Judging fires every banked charge, then consumes them all.
HELLOSPIRE-JUDGE.title: Judge
HELLOSPIRE-JUDGE.description: Unleash EVERY banked Seal charge: each fires its Judge effect, then the whole bank is consumed. Judge X times fires each charge X times first. Judging with no Seals banked still counts as Judging for powers that care.
HELLOSPIRE-TITHE.title: Tithe
HELLOSPIRE-TITHE.description: When you discard this card, its Tithe effect triggers and the card stays in your discard pile. A Tithe never Exhausts -- only the card's true cast does.
HELLOSPIRE-LEAD_ROUND.title: Lead Round
HELLOSPIRE-HEAVY_ROUND.title: Heavy Round
HELLOSPIRE-CRIPPLING_ROUND.title: Crippling Round
HELLOSPIRE-PIERCING_ROUND.title: Piercing Round
HELLOSPIRE-GUARD_ROUND.title: Guard Round
HELLOSPIRE-SMOKE_ROUND.title: Smoke Round
HELLOSPIRE-RENDING_ROUND.title: Rending Round
HELLOSPIRE-BLACK_POWDER_ROUND.title: Black Powder Round
HELLOSPIRE-DEAD_MANS_ROUND.title: Dead Man’s Round
HELLOSPIRE-EMPTY_CHAMBER.title: Empty Chamber
HELLOSPIRE-INFUSE.title: Infuse
HELLOSPIRE-INFUSE.description: Add a stored Damage, Poison, Block or Energy value to your Unstable Concoction, if you're holding one. Does nothing if you aren't.
HELLOSPIRE-UNLEASH.title: Unleash
HELLOSPIRE-UNLEASH.description: Use your Unstable Concoction. Everything Infused into it resolves at once, on whatever it's used on.
